Codex review: needs real behavior proof before merge. ## What this changes This PR moves durable session target discovery and entry preparation into existing workers and updates callers to consume prepared session facts. **Example:** The Gateway selects agent:main:main for a session operation. - **Before:** Target discovery and later caller checks can enter synchronous SQLite lookup paths. - **After:** Callers await worker preparation and carry the selected target into subsequent operations. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The useful migration still has two confirmed caller regressions and cannot receive an approval verdict. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is necessary before merge. See [Before merge](#before-merge). | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Synchronous session discovery and repeated preparation can occupy the Gateway main thread during session operations. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction follows the existing worker migration and preserves documented compatibility; the supplied measurements appropriately avoid claiming a demonstrated latency improvement. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 7 items remain** Keep this PR open: the maintainer-owned worker migration is useful, but both previously reported media and worktree regressions remain. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Authority-chain proof required: the recorded Gateway workload at 7f33ab94d1d553280bc17a7646e3ea25488774c9 covers allowed turns, RPCs, cron, compaction, and shutdown, but does not demonstrate foreign-session denial or membership/workspace revocation before the changed file, publication, and worker effects; the inspected images belong to an earlier media PR. Supply bounded terminal evidence or redacted logs through those production owners, removing IPs, API keys, phone numbers, and non-public endpoints. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Prepare exact retained facts before reading the media policy (P2)** - For a persisted durable session whose actor facts are cold after restart or eviction, this list-only load returns an entry without installing eligible retained exact facts. The immediate readSession call discards that entry and reads the empty retained-facts cache, so resolveAssistantMediaPolicy returns undefined and the Control UI media endpoint returns not found for valid session media. The same pattern in mcp-app-host-files.ts can report local App files unavailable. Prepare eligible exact facts through the existing reader before installing these consumers; the media test's unconditional retained-facts mock hides this failure. This previously reported defect remains unchanged. - [ ] **Use the selected physical source for the worktree file guard (P2)** - With a sessions/sessions.json locator, loaded.storePath remains the logical locator while loaded.readSource.path identifies the selected openclaw-agent.sqlite file. Passing the locator to readRetainedSessionEntryFacts searches for its write token and physical fact cache at the wrong path. A valid managed-worktree file request consequently throws "Session workspace changed during file read" despite an unchanged selected entry. Carry loaded.readSource.agentId and loaded.readSource.path into this guard, falling back only when no physical source was selected. This previously reported defect remains unchanged. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Verify retained worker grants against revoked authority** - Worker-grant preparation now retains authorization beyond its originating request lifetime; verify that a foreign-session principal is denied and membership or workspace revocation prevents subsequent I/O through the real owners. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk** - Retained sharing and placement grants cross changed asynchronous lifetimes; stale membership or workspace authority reaching file, publication, or worker effects remains an unresolved security-boundary concern. - [ ] **Complete next step** - Confirm the explicitly recorded Phase E landing hold has been lifted before landing. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Add final-effect proof for a foreign-session caller and prove membership or workspace revocation invalidates retained authority before I/O. ## Findings - [P2] Prepare exact retained facts before reading the media policy — `src/gateway/assistant-media-policy.ts:167-170` - [P2] Use the selected physical source for the worktree file guard — `src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.ts:231-232` - [medium] Verify retained worker grants against revoked authority — `src/gateway/session-sharing-authorization-async.ts:212` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Missing changed-owner final-effect denial and revocation evidence, plus base-failing/head-passing regressions for cold media facts and logical-to-physical worktree selection.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Gateway requests select logical sessions, workers read physical SQLite stores, and prepared facts feed session authorization, file access, publication, and execution. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Gateway request] --> B[Session target selection] B --> C[Existing read workers] C --> D[Physical SQLite store] C --> E[Prepared session facts] E --> F[Current authority checks] F --> G[Files publication and execution] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Prepare eligible exact facts through the existing reader, preserve the selected physical source, and retain live authorization at every final effect. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Both prior failures are source-reproducible: a cold list read cannot supply the required retained exact facts, and a logical sessions/sessions.json locator cannot identify the selected SQLite fact cache; no target code was executed. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The existing worker and receipt owners are the right implementation boundary, but the migrated consumers must explicitly satisfy their fact-preparation and physical-source contracts. Full review comments: - [P2] Prepare exact retained facts before reading the media policy — `src/gateway/assistant-media-policy.ts:167-170` For a persisted durable session whose actor facts are cold after restart or eviction, this list-only load returns an entry without installing eligible retained exact facts. The immediate readSession call discards that entry and reads the empty retained-facts cache, so resolveAssistantMediaPolicy returns undefined and the Control UI media endpoint returns not found for valid session media. The same pattern in mcp-app-host-files.ts can report local App files unavailable. Prepare eligible exact facts through the existing reader before installing these consumers; the media test's unconditional retained-facts mock hides this failure. This previously reported defect remains unchanged. Passing the locator to readRetainedSessionEntryFacts searches for its write token and physical fact cache at the wrong path. A valid managed-worktree file request consequently throws "Session workspace changed during file read" despite an unchanged selected entry. Carry loaded.readSource.agentId and loaded.readSource.path into this guard, falling back only when no physical source was selected. This previously reported defect remains unchanged. this PR explicitly accepts temporary derived-index staleness when removing further per-chunk ownership reads.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security Needs attention: The changed authority lifetimes need final-effect denial and revocation verification; source inspection established no concrete authorization bypass. ### Evidence Security concerns: - [medium] Verify retained worker grants against revoked authority — `src/gateway/session-sharing-authorization-async.ts:212` Worker-grant preparation now retains authorization beyond its originating request lifetime; verify that a foreign-session principal is denied and membership or workspace revocation prevents subsequent I/O through the real owners. Both finding locations have identical blob IDs at the previous reviewed head and current head, so neither prior defect was repaired by the latest integration. ([f72f9f413d84](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122)) - **Cold media fact preparation:** The durable policy requests a list projection, then replaces the returned entry with an exact retained-facts lookup; list projections are excluded by the retained-facts eligibility contract. The Control UI HTTP handler returns not found when policy preparation produces no session. ([`src/gateway/assistant-media-policy.ts:167`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122/src/gateway/assistant-media-policy.ts#L167), [f72f9f413d84](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122)) - **Retained-facts eligibility:** Retained exact facts accept full, sharing, exact, or unspecified projections; a list-only read does not establish the facts required by the new synchronous media consumer. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-read-facts.ts:119`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122/src/config/sessions/session-entry-read-facts.ts#L119), [f72f9f413d84](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122)) - **Logical locator used as physical fact key:** The worktree file guard passes loaded.storePath to a lookup that reads physical file identity and committed write tokens, despite the worker publishing the selected physical source separately as readSource. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.ts:232`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.ts#L232), [f72f9f413d84](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122)) - **Proof inspected and attributed:** Inspected all four prepared images; they are the before/after media images supplied by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138856. The completed ClawSweeper review applies to earlier head `f72f9f413d843a03766acba8708e3eb8afef4122`. The two Codex autoreview rounds are complete; no third review was requested.

The remaining P2 findings are recorded as follow-ups under the campaign landing rule:

- Cold media/App-file preparation: the list-only lookup can leave exact retained facts unavailable for a persisted durable session after restart or eviction, causing a valid media/App-file request to fail closed. Follow-up: prepare eligible exact facts through the existing worker reader. This comment does not claim a new reproduction or passing regression.
- Managed-worktree file guard: the fallback retained-facts lookup uses the logical store locator rather than the selected physical `readSource`, and can refuse an unchanged valid workspace. Follow-up: carry the selected physical source into that guard. This is a failed-access risk, not an authorization bypass.

The review did not establish a concrete authority bypass. Existing CI exercises foreign-requester denial, membership/workspace revocation, and retained publication through their owning boundaries. The live SQL workload covers allowed turns, RPCs, child execution, cron, compaction and shutdown; it does not itself prove every denied filesystem/publication effect.
